item.title: Historic Ocala church needs help to finish building new sanctuary
item.description: Mount Moriah Missionary Baptist Church, whose previous facility in downtown Ocala was demolished to make way for the city's second parking garage, is asking local residents for support as it faces a significant financial shortfall in the construction of its new sanctuary. Read more: Historic Ocala church needs help to finish building new sanctuary

item.title: Coral Anne Swiger
item.description: Coral Swiger was kind, caring, and endlessly compassionate, the first to step forward when someone needed help, even a stranger. She loved her family fiercely and was truly the glue that held everyone together. Read more: Coral Anne Swiger

item.title: Ocala robber who stabbed Paddock Mall shooter in jail gets 45-year sentence
item.description: A Marion County Jail inmate accused of robbing an Ocala bank and stabbing fellow inmate Albert James Shell, Jr., the suspect in the deadly 2023 Paddock Mall shooting, has been sentenced to 45 years in prison. Read more: Ocala robber who stabbed Paddock Mall shooter in jail gets 45-year sentence

item.title: State accuses Ocala doctor of documenting false symptoms for healthy patient
item.description: The Florida Department of Health has filed a formal administrative complaint against an Ocala cardiologist, alleging that he documented false and contradictory symptoms to justify unnecessary medical procedures for a patient. Read more: State accuses Ocala doctor of documenting false symptoms for healthy patient

item.title: Large rhesus macaque at Silver Springs State Park
item.description: Check out this large, dominant male rhesus macaque photographed at Silver Springs State Park while paddleboarding the river. Thanks to Mike McQueary for sharing! Read more: Large rhesus macaque at Silver Springs State Park

item.title: I love and enjoy talking to people who have moved to Ocala.
item.description: "I have lived here since July 1999. I have never sat through 2 lights to get across SR 200. Even when it was only 2 lanes. All I am hearing is people complaining about how many people are moving to Ocala and how it is causing so much traffic problems. Bull! I love Ocala and enjoy talking to people who moved here. They love it and have no plans on leaving. However, we have so many that are so upset because others came here and also love it. Enjoy our beautiful Marion County and be happy for other
